_about: Family lists skipped by Story only in Watch and in the Listen page (Obay, 2026-11-28). Verse ranges, first and last verse, of runs of 3 or more verses that hold nothing but names, ages and 'fathered' / 'sons of'. Verses that tell something stay in, and so does a heading like 'These are the generations of Shem' that tells the listener whose list is skipped. "all" marks a chapter that is a family list from start to end (skipped whole). The text is never changed: scripts/build.py turns these into times in site/manifest.json, and scripts/notices.py records the spoken notices.
